description:
This tool calls the Actor "johto.data/faa-drone-data" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: FAA drone data for AI agents: active Part 107 waivers (company, waiver number, waived rules like BVLOS 107.31, over people 107.39, night, altitude, dates) plus FRIA Remote ID flying sites with location. Filter by rule, keyword, state, date. $0.02/record.

This tool requires an x402 payment. Include a valid x402 payment signature in the request metadata (_meta["x402/payment"]). Your MCP client must support the x402 payment protocol.

activeOnly.description:
Skip expired waivers/sites. Waivers that are not yet in effect (status 'upcoming') are kept.
Example values: true
activeOnly.title: Active only

datasets.description:
Which official FAA datasets to return.
Example values: ["waivers"]
datasets.title: Datasets

issuedAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Waivers: effectiveFrom date (FAA's 'Date of Issuance' column, which is when the waiver takes effect). FRIA: start date. Empty = all.
issuedAfter.title: Effective / started on or after

maxItems.description:
Maximum records; each is one charged result ($0.002). Default 10 keeps an empty-input call a cheap sample; raise it for the full list.
Example values: 25
maxItems.title: Max results

onlyNew.description: Remember results across runs (per account) and return only items not seen before. Ideal for scheduled runs: you pay only for new records.
onlyNew.title: Only new since last run

regulations.description:
Waived Part 107 sections to keep, e.g. ["107.31"] (BVLOS), ["107.39"] (over people), ["107.29"] (night), ["107.51(b)"] (altitude). Empty = all.
Example values: ["107.31"]

items.description: Waived Part 107 sections to keep, e.g. ["107.31"] (BVLOS), ["107.39"] (over people), ["107.29"] (night), ["107.51(b)"] (altitude). Empty = all.
items.title: Waived regulations (waivers)

regulations.title: Waived regulations (waivers)

states.description: Two-letter states for FRIA sites. Empty = all.

items.description: Two-letter states for FRIA sites. Empty = all.
items.title: States (FRIA)

states.title: States (FRIA)

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

webhookUrl.description: Optional. POSTs the new items as JSON with a 'text'/'content' summary (Slack, Discord, Zapier, Make, n8n compatible).
webhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL
